title: Lorentz Invariance
description: Essential Criteria: Demonstrate that E . B = 0 and E^2 = c^2 B^2 are Lorentz invariant.

title: Field Tensor Relation
description: Important Criteria: Show the equivalence of K . E = 0 to n^mu F_{mu nu} = 0.

title: Field Transformations
description: Essential Criteria: Provide correct expressions for E_x' and B_y' after Lorentz transformation.

title: Energy Density Expressions
description: Important Criteria: Derive the expressions for energy density in both frames.

title: Momentum Density Calculations
description: Important Criteria: Calculate the momentum density in both frames correctly.

title: Total Energy-Momentum Transformation
description: Essential Criteria: Show how total energy and momentum transform as a four-vector.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid mistakes in applying Lorentz transformations or sign errors.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
